description: Import a project from its JSON content (the app's importProjectFromFileContent flow): validates config_version (rejects files newer than the app supports), forces design_id/region to app defaults, adds to the project list. Pass the file content as a string — read the file yourself first. MUTATING (adds a project).

content.description: Project JSON content (a CyberBrick project file exported by project_export or the app).

name.description: Project name; defaults to config_name from the content, else "config". ".json" suffix is stripped.

name: project_import
title: Import project from JSON content
